fault_to_detection_seconds.definition: Conservative upper bound from beginning fault application to first failed sampled echo completion; includes sampling gaps, timeout, and all parent/child launch/return overhead.

first_success_after_restoration_seconds.definition: Conservative upper bound from restoration start to first successful sampled echo; includes restoration, sampling gaps, and all parent/child launch/return overhead. Earlier success may be unobserved.

stable_recovery_seconds.definition: Completion of the error-free post-restoration probe window (at least one second); independent state recovery is evaluated separately. This is a sampled bound, not continuous health assurance.

probe.latency_boundary: successful TCP dial, optional hold, full payload write, half-close and exact echo through EOF
probe.latency_sampling: reservoir of at most 100000 successful operations

probe_window.definition: Parent invocation brackets the child scheduling clock; all launch/return/parsing overhead bounds the unknown child start offset.

snapshot.capture_note: Active capture copies may end with an incomplete final packet; final post-down captures are flushed.

gateway_metrics.accepted_definition: all accepted TCP sockets including sockets immediately rejected at the connection limit
gateway_metrics.cpu_boundary: cumulative CPU seconds for the entire process
gateway_metrics.errors_definition: one terminal failure class per admitted session; connection-limit rejections are counted separately
gateway_metrics.log_policy: 64 queued records plus at most one sink write; overflow is dropped; one blocked sink goroutine may remain until release or process exit
